run_mini_swe_agent: run the mini-swe-agent worker that connects to a GAIA2 adapter via Unix socket and processes task messages
build_mini_agent: build a DefaultAgent wired to LitellmModel and FaketimeLocalEnvironment with configurable model, API key, and step limits
resume_agent_conversation: resume an already-run agent with a new notification while preserving conversation history and synthesizing dangling tool results
install_trace_logging: install trace logging on a LitellmModel so every LLM call appends request and response data to a trace JSONL file
process_message_task: process a message from the adapter queue by running the agent task and sending back a final or error response
